load_hotpotqa_knowledge_source: load HotpotQA knowledge source files from a directory using multi-threaded bz2 decompression
run_thread_parse_bz2_json: parse bz2 compressed JSON lines files and return a dictionary keyed by title
load_ks_with_verbose: load HotpotQA knowledge source from a directory with verbose progress output enabled
run_thread_with_progress: run a threaded file parsing job with periodic percentage progress reporting
load_ks_multi_thread: load knowledge source files across all CPU cores using a thread pool
